authorityLifecycle.baseDriftPolicy: Any protected-main/base drift before R2 materialization stops the program for re-audit, rebind, reformat, re-review, and byte refreeze. After R2, protected main must independently equal the returned exact R2 rebind merge/main SHA before R2 runtime-receipt drafting, immediately before byte-exact R2 approval, and immediately before fresh A1 child/worktree/branch creation. Any mismatch stops before runtime authority or writer creation and requires intervening-main audit plus affected authority rebind, refreeze, review, and approval from the new exact main. Silent rebase, stale-main branch creation, merge-forward, or SHA substitution is forbidden.

closureEvidence.callers: A1 binds changed-file entry, manifest and workspace readers, selector, runner, the explicit completeness CLI, CI unit, nightly entry, and all three collectors. Existing coverage:gate callers were audited: CI unit, pr:verify and its Pilot/release callers, QA command inspection, and local parity. The explicit completeness CLI is added only to CI unit and the independent nightly entry; every other caller retains the default compatibility-locked coverage:gate behavior.
closureEvidence.sharedConsumers: The only shared runtime consumer of A1's new selector/completeness behavior is the existing CI unit job. Full-unit nightly is an independent entry. pr:verify, Pilot verification, release candidate, QA command inspection, and local parity remain callers only of the unchanged default coverage:gate contract and do not consume the new completeness CLI.
closureEvidence.readWriteDelete: A1 reads Git/event/package/manifest/coverage inputs, writes only coverage outputs and temporary shadow receipts/artifacts, and defines artifact/temp cleanup; it has no product, database, provider, repository-variable, or deployment state writer.
closureEvidence.mountErrorPaths: No filesystem mount or external service is required. Missing, malformed, non-relative, stale-head, graph, owner, task, coverage, receipt, or artifact input fails closed to full unit or blocks coverage; no empty selection can pass as completeness.
closureEvidence.capabilityRequirements: Node filesystem/JSON/child-process/timing/hash primitives, pnpm package commands, GitHub Actions step outcomes/artifacts, and GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest are named; protected-main run 32397701546/job 96518444672 proves the special lane read-only.
closureEvidence.testCollectors: S1 has node:test collectors, S2 has an exact-head CI receipt artifact after the full suite, and S3 consumes bound historical/live receipts; every required acceptance row treats skip as failure.
closureEvidence.baselineOwnership: Protected main faae32d2af477c44d2f2fed6ad36151d08b8ea8d owns the factual package/workflow baseline; the unchanged full PR suite is the failure-detection oracle. Main push and A1's separate nightly entry run full coverage plus the explicit completeness CLI. Release remains full and behavior-compatible through pr:verify:hosts; Pilot and local-parity default coverage callers remain unchanged.

highestRiskCases: A QA-only diff reaches a package without test:unit; it must select the declared check owner or full fallback and may never produce an empty successful unit selection.
A changed-file, workspace, dependency, owner, task, manifest, or exact-head lookup is missing, malformed, ambiguous, or stale; the PR must run the full unit suite.

A lockfile, root package-manager/Turbo config, CI workflow/action, generated source, auth, database/schema/RLS, routing/proxy, tenancy, billing, security, release, or unknown path must run the full unit suite.

domain-case and domain-recovery are explicitly summaryless; in the A1 CI unit and nightly entries, any missing or malformed summary for web, shared-auth, or another expected domain package must fail the explicit completeness CLI rather than be filtered.
Any shared default coverage:gate behavior change for pr:verify, Pilot verification, release candidate, QA command inspection, or local parity is a non-goal violation and blocks A1.
The full suite fails while the selected candidate passes; the receipt must record a selector miss, S3 must fail, and A2 must remain blocked.
The selected candidate fails while the full suite passes; the discrepancy must be preserved without masking or rewriting the full-suite conclusion.
Main, nightly, or release accidentally adopts affected-only selection; A1 fails and requires exact-main failure closeout.
A hidden variable, label, timer, automatic transition, workflow side channel, or provider mutation activates skipping; authority is consumed and the program stops.

rollback.mechanism: Before merge, discard only the fresh unmerged A1 child. After merge, preserve exact evidence, merge the mandatory deauthorizing failure closeout, and permit at most one separately reviewed mechanical exact-revert PR only while the A1 merge remains the latest merge touching its writer paths. Revert is temporary containment and never replaces canonical failure closeout.
rollback.trigger: Any unauthorized writer or primitive, admission drift, line-budget breach, skipped required proof, missed full-suite failure, unsafe fallback miss, silent coverage omission, exact-head mismatch, required-check failure, current-main regression, accidental enforcement, CD/provider effect, evidence persistence failure, cleanup failure, or successor promotion without the complete A1→S3→A2 authority chain.

cdContainment.preMerge: Read-only repository-runners API preflight requires no online runner matching both self-hosted and interdomestik-z620-staging. The workflow-runs API requires zero cd.yml runs whose status is anything other than terminal completed, across every event and ref; because every cd.yml invocation shares one repository-wide canonical staging concurrency group, that all-event/all-status workflow query is the observable conflict proof. Pre-arm one watcher bound to exact PR/base/reviewed-head identities.
cdContainment.watcher: Poll the runner inventory and all-event cd.yml workflow inventory once per second for at most 120 seconds. No nonterminal run is allowed before the mutation returns; afterward, only the returned squash SHA's exact push/main run may be nonterminal. Stop on any other nonterminal run, identity drift, or runner-readiness drift. Accept only the squash merge mutation result created with mergeMethod:SQUASH and exact expectedHeadOid.
cdContainment.allowedAction: Identify and cancel only the cd.yml push/main run whose head_sha equals the returned squash SHA, before runner assignment, step start, or provider action; never dispatch, approve, rerun, or mutate another run or provider.
cdContainment.successProof: The matching run reaches terminal cancelled; every job has steps:[] and GitHub unassigned-runner sentinels: runner_id null or 0, runner_name null or empty, and runner_group_id null or 0. Normalize only that complete raw tuple to runner identity null; started_at alone is not assignment evidence.
cdContainment.failureClass: No exact run by 120 seconds, merge/head/base drift, newly capable runner, any other nonterminal cd.yml run across any event/ref/status, cancellation failure, assigned runner, non-empty steps, or any provider effect is containment failure/incident.

postMergeFailureCloseout.success: After A1 implementation exact-main health, CD containment, cleanup, and canonical convergence are green, set runtime_authorized:false and activeSlice:null, keep A2 and all successors blocked, and collect remaining shadow evidence while full PR unit stays required. A1 success closeout may merge only after S1, S2, and S3 are frozen and green; a failure closeout may merge earlier for a preauthorized failure class. Neither path grants enforcement authority.
postMergeFailureCloseout.authorityOrConvergenceFailure: After Phase A, A1 implementation, or A1 closeout, preserve exact merge and run evidence, set runtime_authorized:false, activeSlice:null and successors blocked, consume any active A1 runtime authority, and stop for separate current-authority incident repair without automatic retry.
postMergeFailureCloseout.mainHealthFailure: After Phase A, A1 implementation, or A1 closeout, preserve exact base/head/squash/tree identities, checks and receipts; treat absent main CI as expected only for the two governance-only writer maps; merge the preauthorized sanitized deauthorizing failure closeout when safe, allow at most one separately reviewed exact-revert containment PR under the latest-writer constraint, and keep A2/all successors blocked.
postMergeFailureCloseout.cdOrProviderFailure: If the matching cd.yml run is not terminal cancelled with the complete raw unassigned-runner tuple normalizing to runner identity null and steps:[], or any provider effect occurs, preserve observed effects, classify provider state unknown, perform no provider cleanup mutation or retry, set runtime_authorized:false and activeSlice:null, block successors, and stop for incident authority; cancellation is not deployment authority.
postMergeFailureCloseout.evidenceOrCleanupFailure: Preserve remaining artifacts and dirty state, do not conceal or repeatedly retry failed receipt/branch/worktree/artifact cleanup, set runtime_authorized:false and activeSlice:null, block successors, and require separate cleanup/incident authority.
postMergeFailureCloseout.successorPromotionFailure: Any A2 promotion before independent exact-A1-main admission and explicit approval, or any third tranche, deauthorizes the program, clears activeSlice, blocks all successors, preserves evidence, and stops.
